The abstract describes the general potential of extracellular vesicles (EVs) and exosomes, surveys existing isolation and characterization methods, and highlights the limitations of conventional techniques while noting emerging microfluidic approaches. It does not mention acoustofluidic technology, real‑time machine learning, convolutional neural networks, support vector machines, nanopore sensing, or whole‑blood isolation. Consequently, the specific candidate hypothesis involving an integrated acoustofluidic‑ML system is not presented or supported by the evidence given in the abstract.  

VERDICT: REJECT
